TrySetStateFlag.summary: Attempts to set the specified state flag on the entity and returns a value indicating whether the flag was newly set.
TrySetStateFlag.remarks: This method uses atomic operations to ensure that the state flag is set safely in multithreaded scenarios.
TrySetStateFlag.param: The state flag to set on the entity. This value should be a valid enumeration member.
When this method returns, contains the new state of the entity after the flag has been set.
TrySetStateFlag.returns: if the specified flag was not previously set and is now set; otherwise, .

TryClearStateFlag.summary: Attempts to clear the specified state flag on the entity and returns a value indicating whether the flag was newly cleared.
TryClearStateFlag.remarks: This method uses atomic operations to ensure that the state flag is cleared safely in multithreaded scenarios.
TryClearStateFlag.param: The state flag to clear on the entity. This value should be a valid enumeration member.
When this method returns, contains the new state of the entity after the flag has been cleared.
TryClearStateFlag.returns: if the specified flag was previously set and is now cleared; otherwise, .

SetStateFlag.summary: Sets the specified state flag on the current entity state.
SetStateFlag.returns: The previous state of the entity before setting the flag.

ClearStateFlag.summary: Clears the specified state flag from the current entity state.
ClearStateFlag.returns: The previous state of the entity before clearing the flag.
